title: XSS: unescaped URLs in render_photo_grid
description:
In fieldwork/src/util.rs lines 76-78, file_url and post_url are format-interpolated directly into href and src HTML attributes without escaping. Only alt is sanitized via ammonia::clean(). A file_url or post_url containing a double-quote can break out of the attribute context, and a post_url of javascript:... would execute script on click. All three values should be escaped or validated before interpolation into HTML attributes.

Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/fedistract/fieldwork/src/util.rs:76-78
close_reason: Fixed: escape_html_attr applied to file_url and post_url in render_photo_grid. Tests added.
